hints.title: Position Index Inferred from Set Bit Count
hints.text: The number of chosen integers directly reveals the index currently being filled, eliminating the need to pass both position and subset state.

hints.title: Divisibility Rule Invariant
hints.text: Placing number i at position pos requires either i to divide pos without remainder or pos to divide i without remainder.

hints.title: Bitmask Count Accumulation Procedure
hints.text: Let state mask indicate chosen numbers. The next position is the population count of mask plus one. Base case: full mask returns one. Otherwise sum recursive transitions across all unselected numbers that satisfy divisibility. Memoize state.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input size or search state bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N * 2^N) time and O(2^N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all n! permutations directly requires 15! = 1.3 trillion operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmask DP computes counts across 2^n states in O(n * 2^n) time using O(2^n) memo space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should determine position implicitly from the set bit count and cache overlapping subproblems with a bitmask.
